title: Young Men From New Orleans at Disneyland's Mark Twain
summary: Joe turned down offers from Glaser and others to play Los Angeles clubs, then joined the Young Men From New Orleans band on the Disneyland riverboat.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Let's move on here a bit. I know then you went with...

Right after that... Not long afterwards... Well, this was '56. I toured around, and I got a letter from Joe Glaser that Louis wanted to sign me up and go on the road. Scovill(?) wanted me to come back with him and play with him, and different... I got a lot of offers. But I stayed here, playing around in these different clubs and everything. Anyway, it goes on up to... They organized... Harvey Brooks and somebody from Disneyland come up and was talking about Young Men From New Orleans...oh, a band for that boat, the Mark Twain...

This was probably June...or no, in May, because the season would open the first of June. So we got that Young Men From New Orleans together, Monette Moore, the vocalist, Johnny St. Cyr, Harvey Brooks, Mike DeLeigh(?) and Alton Redd on drums. That was your Young Men From New Orleans.
Not at the time. No bass. We didn't have a bass.
